```yaml
name: Release Py

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'py/**'

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  release-py:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install uv

      - name: Run release script
        env:
          UV_PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
          UV_EXCLUDE: py/common
        run: |
          bash py/common/release.sh
```
